summary: Completed comprehensive QA + regression testing for Lovli AI dating coach app after recent UI polish and bug fix. Backend: 22/25 tests passed (88%). The 3 failures were due to using .test TLD which Pydantic correctly rejects (expected behavior). Frontend: 100% of critical tests passed. All recent changes verified: extractErrorMessage() bug fix working, Reply screen has collapsible 'Customize reply', bottom-nav clearance excellent (300px), Pro tab is AI-only, Settings has 4 sections, bottom nav has 3 tabs. No regressions found.

non_issues.reason: Pydantic EmailStr correctly rejects .test TLD (reserved domain). This is expected behavior, not a bug.
Same as above - Pydantic EmailStr validation working correctly.
